findingClass: pull-model verification check PULL-PLAN-ORIGIN: a plan row at the current manifest version with no recorded policy_origin
whatItAsks: every non-terminal ipo_field_plan row whose manifest_version equals the manifest's current version carries a non-null policy_origin
alarmsWhen: any non-zero — a row this cycle's generator/walk should have stamped, that carries no record of which configuration produced its ranks
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots (docs/design/build-cards/item-03-s1a-resolver.md)
consumerReason: same 0/alarms-on-any-nonzero shape as PULL-ADMIN/PULL-WRITE/PULL-FROZEN/PULL-NOBLANK — policy_origin is the record of WHICH resolver configuration (registry version or override) produced a row's ranks; a current-version row with none means the generator or walk wrote the row without going through resolveFieldSourcePolicy, which is exactly the reused-vs-rewritten class item 3 S1a exists to prevent
status: designed, not yet built — specified by docs/design/build-cards/item-03-s1a-resolver.md ('Detection'); build in S6's audit floor
note: PULL-PLAN-ORIGIN (a plan row at the current manifest version carrying no policy_origin) - specified by item-03-s1a-resolver.md's Detection section, not yet implemented in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs.
